verdict.rationale: RudderStack's docs list a Live Events viewer for source and destination events in near real-time, a Health Dashboard for pipeline metrics, Alerts for critical data issues, and MCP tooling to investigate destination delivery errors with root-cause analysis. Together these cover every element of the story, but each comes only from one-line feature summaries. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of per-destination delivery metrics and failure breakdowns, detail on alert configuration and channels, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the debugger and alerting.
